name: exploration_to_forage_proximity_sources_positive_only_50x50_outer_30x30_inner
description: Train from scratch in a padded 50x50 arena with an interior 30x30 task window, two macro food sources throughout, and shrinking proximity/footprint aids instead of hub-source distance aids.

metadata.notes: Main no-distance-aid test for the padded 30x30 sparse-forage problem. The env is 50x50, randomized food stays inside the interior 30x30 window with layout_margin=10, and the colony is randomized only inside the centered 4x4 window with hub_center_window_size=4. The curriculum always has two macro food sources; early stages make each macro source discoverable by placing many food-source tiles within a local Chebyshev footprint, then shrink that footprint until the final stage is two single-tile sources. Hub-source distance is not staged, distance_bonus is 0, carrying_hub_distance_bonus is 0, and novelty/view rewards are off in the base run so the primary aid is source proximity/footprint rather than trainer-side distance shaping. The centralized critic uses the strided_cnn fallback: 50x50 grid planes pass through stride-2 5x5/3x3/3x3 convolutions, flatten to a 256-unit spatial embedding, fuse with a 128-unit entity/scalar embedding, then pass through a 256-unit fusion layer and value head. The laptop recipe uses one PPO epoch, four minibatches, and less frequent logging for fast iteration.
